translation.example:
import json
import statistics
import time

import numpy as np

from nloptr import (
    auglag, bobyqa, ccsaq, check_derivatives, cobyla, crs2lm, direct, directL,
    is_nloptr, isres, lbfgs, mlsl, mma, neldermead, newuoa, nl_grad, nl_jacobian,
    nl_opts, nloptr, nloptr_get_default_options, nloptr_print_options, sbplx,
    slsqp, stogo, tnewton, varmetric,
)

def one():
    import io
    import contextlib
    buf = io.StringIO()
    with contextlib.redirect_stdout(buf):
        nloptr_print_options(["stopval"])
    text = buf.getvalue()
    if text.endswith("\n"):
        text = text[:-1]
    return text

value = one()
if isinstance(value, str):
    print(value, end='' if value.endswith('\n') else '\n')
elif isinstance(value, bool):
    print('TRUE' if value else 'FALSE')
else:
    shown = np.atleast_1d(np.asarray(value, dtype=float)).ravel()
    print(' '.join('%.16g' % float(part) for part in shown))
